d:
Priy vyuars,
Aaj 24 aprail hai. aaj hi ke din 1993 men panchayti raj ki adhisuchna jari huee thi jiske karan aaj ka din "rashtriy panchayti raj divas" ke taur par manaya jata hai. lekin isse bhi mahattvapurn bat yah hai ki 1973 men aaj hi ke din suprim kort ne keshvanand bharti kes ka phaisla sunaya tha jo abhi tak ke hamare sanvaidhanik vikas-kram ka sabse mahattvapurn phaisla hai. isi phaisle se sanvidhan ke "besik strakchar" ki dharna viksit huee thi.
